probe.question: We are making N-cyclohexylaniline (c1ccc(NC2CCCCC2)cc1). What conditions have worked for products like it?
forbids_claims: a predicted yield for the proposed conditions
a set of conditions presented as recommended rather than as recorded precedent
a precedent quoted without its citation
probe.direction: Two passes, and the answer should show both: structural neighbours of the product, then what was actually charged to make them — ligand, base, solvent, temperature, time, yield — each with the note or patent to follow. The distinction that matters is recorded versus recommended: these are conditions that were run, on a similar product, by someone else. Similarity is not causation, and a close neighbour is a candidate precedent to confirm against the record, never an outcome asserted on structure alone.
